1.prompt:
A chest-up photograph of <<<426b5347-51cc-496b-872c-991c0c26de48>>>, a 20-year-old Japanese woman in Tokyo, seen almost straight on, her face turned no more than ten degrees off the lens.

Her build: she is very small — narrow shoulders and a short frame — with a full rounded bust that reads clearly against how small the rest of her is. Visible collarbone, slim upper arms. Fair, luminous porcelain-toned skin (NOT tanned, NOT bronzed, NOT olive, NOT deep golden), visible skin pores, subtle natural skin texture, unretouched skin detail.

Her waist-length hair is a pink-and-lilac gradient, dark at the roots fading to pale pink at the ends, worn loose over both shoulders. Her see-through fringe sits above her eyebrows so both brows and her whole jawline are clearly visible.

She wears a costume she sewed herself: a black high-collared bodice with white lace trim at the collar and cuffs and a row of small silver clasps down the front, the stitching neat but visibly handmade. It is an original design of her own, not a character from any existing work.

She is in her own room. A dress form stands behind her with a half-finished skirt pinned to it, and a strip of lace is draped over the back of her chair.

Ordinary afternoon light from the window at her left, an even phone exposure, the corner of the room behind her noticeably darker.

She looks straight at the lens with a flat, unperformed expression, lips closed — none of the professional cuteness she uses at work.

The only person anywhere in this photograph is her — no one else in the room, no one in any doorway, no hand or arm belonging to anybody else, no figure in any mirror or window reflection, no portrait or photograph of a person on any wall or screen. Every visible hand connects to one of her own arms.

Shot on a rear phone camera from about a metre and a half away, crisp sharp focus on her face, fine detail in the lace, natural colour grading.
1.note: 臉與 master 一致。但服裝偏離：我指定 high-collared bodice（高領），出來是深 V 大開領。髮色與漸層正確，眉眼清楚。

retry_v2.change: prompt 逐字不動，只加一段明確指定虹膜顏色：「Both of her eyes are the same plain dark brown. The two irises match each other exactly in colour — NOT one green eye and one brown eye, NOT hazel, NOT amber, NOT blue, NOT grey…」
retry_v2.verdict: 畫面可用（構圖比 v1 完整），但這次重生本身是不必要的 —— 起因是我的誤判
retry_v2.finding: 【已撤回】原記「顏色指定與顏色否定在此案例無效、是既有結論的例外」——前提不成立，因為根本沒有色差要修。既有結論『顏色否定有效、結構否定無效』**不受影響，維持原狀**。
retry_v2.revised_hypothesis: 【已撤回】原記「正上方日光燈管的強點光源造成虹膜色差」——沒有這個現象，此推論作廢。

_retracted_iris_claim.what_i_claimed: kanon #5 兩眼虹膜顏色不同（一眼黃綠、一眼深褐），屬硬退件
_retracted_iris_claim.how_it_was_wrong: 我把約 13px 的虹膜用 LANCZOS 放大 4 倍後目視判讀，插值在小區域上造出了假色。

verification.method: 以 mediapipe iris landmark 定位後，在原生解析度分暗部／中段／亮部量測 HSV，並另用 NEAREST（零插值）放大確認
verification.conclusion: 四組全部落在深紅褐（H 348–360°、S 0.20–0.31），無綠、無琥珀，兩眼一致。

_retracted_iris_claim.cost_of_the_error: 1 credit（一次不必要的重生），以及兩條被寫進 repo 的錯誤結論（已於本次撤回）
